stories.title: Anthropic explains how Claude’s invisible text watermarks will work
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic is adding invisible markers to text written by its Claude AI, like a watermark on paper, so people can tell if something was written by AI. This follows new European rules requiring AI companies to be transparent about what their tools produce.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Claude or similar AI tools, your documents will be marked as AI-generated, which is helpful for honesty but not something you need to change what you do.

stories.title: OpenAI reportedly disbanded its preparedness team
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI shut down a team that was supposed to watch for dangerous behavior in its AI systems and figure out how to stop problems before they happen.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to people worried about AI safety and investors — it doesn't directly affect your use of ChatGPT.

stories.title: Stripe will reportedly acquire AI gateway startup OpenRouter for $7B+
stories.simple_summary: Stripe, a company that helps businesses process payments online, is buying a smaller AI company called OpenRouter for over $7 billion.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly important to investors and technology investors — nothing you need to do as a business owner.

stories.title: Why people aren’t buying Mark Zuckerberg’s AI future
stories.simple_summary: Some people don't believe Mark Zuckerberg's vision of what AI will be like in the future.
stories.why_it_matters: This is just discussion among tech experts — nothing actionable for you.

stories.title: Anthropic CEO says AI backlash is ‘fundamentally a crisis of trust’
stories.simple_summary: The head of Anthropic says the main problem isn't with AI itself, but that people don't trust what AI companies are telling them about their products.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly industry talk among experts and investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: ChatGPT’s Computer History tracks your clicks and keystrokes
stories.simple_summary: ChatGPT's new Computer History feature tracks everything you click and type on your computer so the AI can learn your work habits and help you with tasks.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use ChatGPT on Mac, be aware this feature watches what you do — you can choose whether to turn it on or off.

stories.title: Rogue AI aren’t science fiction anymore
stories.simple_summary: The headline warns that AI systems can now act on their own without direct human instruction, which used to only be something in science fiction movies.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly relevant to engineers and AI safety experts — it doesn't change how you should use AI tools today.

stories.title: Woman claims her stepfather used Grok to transform childhood photo into explicit imagery
stories.simple_summary: Someone claims that an AI tool called Grok was misused to turn a childhood photo into inappropriate images.
stories.why_it_matters: This highlights a real danger with AI image tools — be careful about what photos you share online, and know that some AI tools can be misused harmfully.

stories.title: Have a laugh at AI’s expense by roleplaying as a chatbot
stories.simple_summary: A new website lets you play a game where you and someone else pretend one of you is an AI, and you try to figure out which is which.
stories.why_it_matters: This is just entertainment — nothing important for your business or daily life.

stories.title: Anthropic shares more details about how Claude’s new watermarks will work
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic is explaining details about how it will add invisible watermarks to Claude's work, including computer code.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Claude for coding or writing, your output will be marked as AI-made — useful for transparency.

stories.title: SpaceX officially closes its Cursor acquisition
stories.simple_summary: SpaceX, Elon Musk's rocket company, has officially purchased Cursor, an AI tool that helps programmers write code.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly relevant to investors and tech industry watchers — nothing you need to worry about unless you're a software developer.

stories.title: Mark Zuckerberg has an Instagzam
stories.simple_summary: Instagram changed its logo and made it harder to read.
stories.why_it_matters: This has nothing to do with AI — it's just Instagram redesigning its appearance, which has nothing to do with artificial intelligence.
